svg.title: Ellis: character sheet
svg.desc: Ellis. Class: Operator, ex-Head of Ecommerce. Main skill: paid search. Off-hand: CRO testing. Spec: self-hosting. Keystone, Kill/Scale Thresholds: set kill/scale thresholds before you spend a penny. Drawback: cannot spend a penny without one.
svg.text: Ex-Head of Ecommerce, now building things I own.
Ship it. Test it. Keep what wins.
Self-hosting everything on an old gaming PC.
